description: This file defines the 'Mem' cache class within the Opencart system, providing methods to get, set, and delete cache entries using PHP's Memcache extension.

classes.name: Mem
classes.description: A class that interfaces with the Memcache extension to perform caching operations specifically in the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcache connection with optional expiry time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiry.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.
